ReportQueryDefinition.Name: Статистика почтовых рассылок по категориям
ReportQueryDefinition.Command: SELECT g.name AS gr_name, COUNT(m.id) AS count_konv, SUM(m.fee) AS total_fee, SUM(m.declared_value) AS total_val, CAST(m.date_created AS DATE) AS date_stat FROM mails m JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id JOIN groups g ON c.group_id = g.id WHERE m.date_created BETWEEN :DateFrom AND :DateTo GROUP BY g.name, CAST(m.date_created AS DATE) ORDER BY date_stat DESC, gr_name ASC;

SELECT g.name AS gr_name, COUNT(m.id) AS count_konv, SUM(m.fee) AS total_fee, SUM(m.declared_value) AS total_val, date(m.date_created) AS date_stat FROM mails m JOIN counterparties c ON m.counterparty_id = c.id JOIN groups g ON c.group_id = g.id WHERE m.date_created BETWEEN :DateFrom AND :DateTo GROUP BY g.name, date(m.date_created) ORDER BY date_stat DESC, gr_name ASC;
